generate_video_from_streamer: generate a video from a snippet streamer with optional volumetric fusion and OBB overlays
render_views_for_snippet: render 2D visualization views for a snippet including RGB, SLAM, and OBB predictions
draw_scene_with_mesh_and_obbs: draw a 3D scene view of a snippet with optional mesh and oriented bounding boxes
compose_views_vertical_or_horizontal: compose multiple snippet image views into a single stacked image vertically or horizontally
fill_obbs_to_snippet: fill oriented bounding boxes into a snippet by matching timestamps and transforming coordinates
